policy: Count distinct root causes; repeated assertions and harness retries are not additional issues.

issues.problem: Title music initialized Web Audio before a real gesture, producing a browser autoplay warning.
issues.fix: Wait for a trusted gesture and native audio.ready before scheduling music or SFX.

issues.problem: Title footer text rows overlapped at 1920x1080.
issues.fix: Separate hint, cartridge metadata and input prompts; increase main menu text.

issues.problem: Play-screen early layout return left the contextual repair target and menu rectangles stale.
issues.caughtBy: Code review of touch layout update path
issues.fix: Recompute field hit targets and repair availability during every update, independent of draw.

issues.problem: A shot aligned to a bunker cell boundary could repeatedly collide with an adjacent cell that erosion did not remove.
issues.caughtBy: Lossy Hub semantic remote fire/repair test; diagnosed in repairDebug snapshot
issues.fix: Pass the actual first-hit cell to erosion and crater about that cell; add an ordinary hold-fire regression at x306.

issues.problem: Pointer-down actions and native compatibility clicks could advance credits twice and reuse an attract wake click.
issues.caughtBy: Browser credits pagination and consumed click wake checks
issues.fix: Use one pointer action route, and consume the full wake gesture including a click following wake motion.

issues.problem: Pointer capture rejects synthetic touch pointer IDs, interrupting the touch test stand-in.
issues.fix: Capture real pointers defensively, while allowing synthetic test pointer events to exercise the same action route.

issues.problem: Desktop-sized menu rows would be too small as touch targets on a portrait phone.
issues.caughtBy: Portrait scale calculation and follow-up CSS target-size assertions
issues.fix: Use 56-logical-unit portrait rows, larger type and generous spacing.

issues.problem: Native touch START remained visible alongside the custom menu button.
issues.fix: Default native touch-button layer to Hidden; keep the relative touch handler and contextual repair.

issues.problem: Developer entry directly into flagship core phase displayed the emitter-phase instruction.
issues.fix: Choose phase-specific entry and control text.

issues.problem: Bright planet bands weakened the contrast of light-colored alien silhouettes.
issues.fix: Give every original sprite a dark native pixel outline.

issues.problem: A quick right mouse repair click could begin and end between updates and be lost by held-state sampling.
issues.fix: Sample both pressed edges and held state for fire and repair.

issues.problem: Long touch control descriptions overflowed the portrait right edge.
issues.fix: Wrap descriptions to the available width and increase row spacing.

issues.problem: About page count overlapped the last button, and longer text needed a per-layout page capacity.
issues.caughtBy: Credits screenshot inspection and per-layout text measurement
issues.fix: Move page numbering to the header and split long report text into readable pages.

issues.problem: Rotating from a long portrait About layout could leave its page index beyond the shorter landscape page list.
issues.caughtBy: Final resize-path review and a phone/tablet last-page rotation regression
issues.fix: Clamp the UI page during layout and read a valid page defensively while drawing.

issues.problem: Tall portrait menu spacing clipped the last title action on the shorter tablet layout; the custom in-game touch menu also needed a physical thumb-sized target.
issues.caughtBy: Tablet About/rotation regression, diagnosed with page/viewport state, and touch target-size calculation
issues.fix: Use a compact portrait composition and fit menu rows to shorter displays. Place a larger contextual menu target in available portrait space or the landscape HUD.
